compatibility.newWorkspaceField: accounts[].reward_title from the account's current rule
compatibility.newFrontendWithOldServer: Old-cycle card uses a truthful generic reward label until the server snapshot field is present
compatibility.storageUnavailableBeforePreparation: Do not send a write without a durable request identity
compatibility.preparedUnknownWrite: Keep the original identity in memory and storage; block changed parameters until original resolution

renderingMeasurement.environment: Desktop Edge loopback fixture; immediate simulated RPC; same dataset, controller render plus layout
renderingMeasurement.limitations: Not production RPC latency, cold load, mobile CPU or network. The legacy workspace still transfers the full dataset; only DOM rendering is paged.

releaseOrder: ROOT accepts the exact source commit and CI; check compatibility with the current assembly and assign shared PWA versions
Qualify the complete isolated DB/Auth/Storage contour and protected original according to project gates
Apply/read/exact isolated rollback/reapply; compare definitions, grants, triggers and all data
Obtain the separate production SQL write authorization for the reviewed exact migration
ROOT applies the approved SQL and publishes the coordinated frontend resources
Verify actual resources/PWA and authenticated target-route behavior at 390/760/1440; physical device evidence separately

recovery.operationalHoldEffect: Keep membership protection and all data; temporarily disable public Loyalty reads/writes and accrual triggers. Bookings remain outside this hold.
recovery.holdWindowCompletions: Not backfilled automatically. Any reconciliation requires a separate reviewed decision.
recovery.resume: Reapply the reviewed forward migration; grants and both accrual triggers are restored
recovery.exactBaselineRollback: isolated-exact-rollback.sql; TEST ONLY because baseline has the known membership bug; requires the explicit isolated-test marker

exclusions: No main, provider.html, provider.js, styles.css or sw.js changes in this package
No working records, payments, messages or production SQL writes
No full restore, physical device or live acceptance claim from fixtures
